title: Cerulean Hail
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A new 4th-level wizard spell: Cerulean Hail, a storm of fist-sized blue hailstones, Athas's precious water made into a weapon. 1d4 cold damage per level of the caster (at most 10d4) to all in a small circle, half with a save; those who fail are battered to their knees and slowed through the next round. It uses Ice Storm's icon and look. Off: the game has only the original's spells.
